environment: Linux datacenter VM; fresh virtual environment and empty per-sample data directories; no ambient credentials, browser sessions or user cookies

methods.live_failover: The installed JSON CLI starts its ordinary detached worker. A probe-only sitecustomize hook injects TimeoutError only while the primary_download stack is active, at its HTTP/subprocess boundary. Fallback HTTP requests, bytes, media finalization and CLI export are unmodified.
methods.security_faults: The same primary-only boundary injects an identity ValueError, calls the actual forbidden-host validator, or raises ENOSPC. A single rejected/failed primary attempt and no completed output are required.
methods.recovery: A short CLI observation timeout reconnects to the original job. A separate test terminates only its own worker session after a pause marker, then explicitly retries that job. Export corruption modifies only that probe file.
methods.media: ffprobe stream/size inspection, normal finalizer checks, one-second decode of the CLI export, matching SHA-256, no-overwrite, deduplication and namespace checks for completed samples.
methods.discovery: Queries and account samples use the independently installed Client without ambient API keys. Indexed candidates do not imply media availability.

limits: Per-sample observations, not platform-wide uptime or exhaustive format guarantees.
LinkedIn retains a historical direct fallback success but no fresh installed failover success in this run.
TikTok, X and Facebook alternatives retain prior unavailable states; no new transferable fallback is claimed. Reddit remains unavailable.
The independent YouTube connector is unverified without an actual operator-owned instance. SnapYT relay switching is not an independent provider.
Recognized share/attachment URL syntax is separate from demonstrated selected-post binding and native format coverage.
The Mastodon fallback sample remains natively silent gifv. Audio-video and arbitrary federation are not demonstrated by it.
One indexed Pinterest native-video pin completed the installed acquisition/export path; this is a narrow discovery sample.
Fresh YouTube and Instagram account-sample attempts returned SearchUnavailable; earlier account checks remain historical.
The fresh YouTube Shorts audio track had an empty relay language/track label; audio presence and stream-copy handling passed, but original-language identity was not independently established.
HLS/DASH, optional new integrations and UI publication remain outside this candidate.
